children: on Thursday unveiled its new Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar artificial intelligence model, aimed at bringing a “real-time visual presence” to conversational AI.

“By pairing near real-time video generation with speech, the Live Avatar feature creates an experience that listens, sees, and speaks with a dynamic visual persona,” Google said in a blog post. “With precise lip-syncing, natural expressions, and fluid turn-taking, Live Avatar enables enterprises to expand their virtual offerings more interactively. Whether providing engaging customer service or delivering interactive walkthroughs, it transforms digital exchanges into richer, more accessible experiences.”
Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar is available in Gemini Enterprise, the tech giant added.

Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS models, aimed at improving audio.
